content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Describe the structure of root hair cells
Explain how water is absorbed by roots
Describe the pathways of water movement through roots
Explain how minerals are absorbed by roots
Water enters plants through the roots, specifically through
. Understanding how roots absorb water and minerals explains the first step in the transpiration stream and shows how plants obtain the resources they need for growth.
